name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created example.py with the exact code from the quickstart, and executed it. The API call returned audio data successfully. To verify in the sandbox (which has no speakers), I also saved the returned audio stream to output.mp3 — the file is 43,511 bytes and confirmed by `file` to be a valid MPEG ADTS layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural. The promised outcome (text-to-speech generates an audio file from text) is demonstrably working.
deviations: The quickstart instructs using `play(audio)` to play through speakers. In the sandbox environment (no audio output device), the script ran successfully but produced no audible output. To verify the outcome, I saved the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) and confirmed it is a valid MP3. This is the only deviation — necessary due to sandbox hardware limitations.

env_ready.evidence: cd /home/daytona && pip install elevenlabs python-dotenv" exit=0

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
